sections.title: The flowers are offered, not merely displayed
sections.bodyMarkdown:
Two childlike figures face each other in a courtyard enclosed by yellow buildings. The taller figure, in a red hood and blue clothing, holds a cup containing a white flower and leans towards the smaller figure. The smaller figure wears an orange-red head covering and a dark-spotted garment, looking up at the other.

Four more flower-filled cups stand in the foreground, with a sixth on a stone pedestal at the rear left. White star-shaped flowers and green leaves recur across them. Further back on the left, a figure walks away with their back to the viewer. There is exchange, shelter and movement in different directions: the figures’ actions and orientations are not all the same. [View the card image](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cups06.jpg)

sections.title: Waite records both the past and unfamiliar surroundings
sections.bodyMarkdown:
The 1911 English transcription of Waite’s The Pictorial Key to the Tarot begins with children in an old garden and names the past, childhood memories and vanished happiness. It also records an opposite reading: the children might be in unfamiliar surroundings, encountering new relationships and knowledge. [Waite’s entry for this card](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktcu06.htm)

The reversed entry favours the future and renewal. This site therefore connects upright memory with reversed movement forward while retaining the openness of both readings. Nostalgia is not presented as the only interpretation all readers agree on.

sections.title: Upright: Identify the actions behind the warmth
sections.bodyMarkdown:
When you miss a person or a period of life, ask what mattered in practical terms. Perhaps someone listened without interrupting, meals had a shared rhythm, or help was given without an ulterior motive. Naming these actions makes a memory usable in the present.

Kindness can be simple: remember a friend’s preferences, share a suitable book, or practise a skill you enjoyed as a child. It need not require the other person to return to an earlier version of the relationship, nor become a debt of favours.

sections.title: Reversed: You need not keep playing your old role
sections.bodyMarkdown:
The reversal can invite a fresh look at the present. An old friend’s life has changed; the role you once played well may no longer fit. Past closeness is worth valuing, but current boundaries, time and values still need to be discussed.

If you remember only the best of the past, write down some of its difficulties too. If the past was not warm, there is no need to beautify it to fit a card meaning. Renewal can preserve useful experience while refusing to repeat painful ways of relating.

sections.title: Turn nostalgia into something small and real
sections.bodyMarkdown:
When meeting a former classmate after years apart, ask about their current life rather than only repeating old nicknames. You can share memories and accept that your interests no longer fully match.

While sorting old work, find one method that once made creating enjoyable and try it in a small exercise today. If a family member says you used to be different, calmly explain your present choices and arrangements. Closeness does not oblige you to preserve the same division of responsibilities forever.

sections.title: Practice: Keep one useful action
sections.bodyMarkdown: Choose a memory you are willing to revisit and describe what someone actually did, rather than only saying those were good times. Try one action that still fits today, noting which conditions have changed. If looking back is uncomfortable, use a recent small kindness instead.

sections.title: A common misreading
sections.bodyMarkdown: The Six of Cups cannot prove an ex will return or guarantee that an old relationship is safe. Familiarity can lower your guard; renewed contact still depends on present wishes and behaviour. The pictured children are artistic figures, not evidence of pregnancy, parenthood or a particular child’s future.

articleMarkdown:
# Six of Cups Meaning: Bring old warmth into the present

In one sentence: Memories offer clues, but people and relationships still need to be understood as they are today.

Card: Six of Cups  
Rank: VI · RWS Minor Arcana · Cups  
Keywords: Memory · Kindness · Familiarity

Upright at a glance: Find support in good past experiences and value simple, specific acts of care.  
Reversed at a glance: Loosen old roles a little to make space for new relationships and ways of living.

An old object can take you back to an afternoon when someone treated you kindly. The Six of Cups values that familiarity while reminding you that people keep changing even when a memory stands still.

## The flowers are offered, not merely displayed

Two childlike figures face each other in a courtyard enclosed by yellow buildings. The taller figure, in a red hood and blue clothing, holds a cup containing a white flower and leans towards the smaller figure. The smaller figure wears an orange-red head covering and a dark-spotted garment, looking up at the other.

Four more flower-filled cups stand in the foreground, with a sixth on a stone pedestal at the rear left. White star-shaped flowers and green leaves recur across them. Further back on the left, a figure walks away with their back to the viewer. There is exchange, shelter and movement in different directions: the figures’ actions and orientations are not all the same. [View the card image](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cups06.jpg)

## Waite records both the past and unfamiliar surroundings

The 1911 English transcription of Waite’s The Pictorial Key to the Tarot begins with children in an old garden and names the past, childhood memories and vanished happiness. It also records an opposite reading: the children might be in unfamiliar surroundings, encountering new relationships and knowledge. [Waite’s entry for this card](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktcu06.htm)

The reversed entry favours the future and renewal. This site therefore connects upright memory with reversed movement forward while retaining the openness of both readings. Nostalgia is not presented as the only interpretation all readers agree on.

## Upright: Identify the actions behind the warmth

When you miss a person or a period of life, ask what mattered in practical terms. Perhaps someone listened without interrupting, meals had a shared rhythm, or help was given without an ulterior motive. Naming these actions makes a memory usable in the present.

Kindness can be simple: remember a friend’s preferences, share a suitable book, or practise a skill you enjoyed as a child. It need not require the other person to return to an earlier version of the relationship, nor become a debt of favours.

## Reversed: You need not keep playing your old role

The reversal can invite a fresh look at the present. An old friend’s life has changed; the role you once played well may no longer fit. Past closeness is worth valuing, but current boundaries, time and values still need to be discussed.

If you remember only the best of the past, write down some of its difficulties too. If the past was not warm, there is no need to beautify it to fit a card meaning. Renewal can preserve useful experience while refusing to repeat painful ways of relating.

## Turn nostalgia into something small and real

When meeting a former classmate after years apart, ask about their current life rather than only repeating old nicknames. You can share memories and accept that your interests no longer fully match.

While sorting old work, find one method that once made creating enjoyable and try it in a small exercise today. If a family member says you used to be different, calmly explain your present choices and arrangements. Closeness does not oblige you to preserve the same division of responsibilities forever.

## Practice: Keep one useful action

Choose a memory you are willing to revisit and describe what someone actually did, rather than only saying those were good times. Try one action that still fits today, noting which conditions have changed. If looking back is uncomfortable, use a recent small kindness instead.

## A common misreading

The Six of Cups cannot prove an ex will return or guarantee that an old relationship is safe. Familiarity can lower your guard; renewed contact still depends on present wishes and behaviour. The pictured children are artistic figures, not evidence of pregnancy, parenthood or a particular child’s future.

## Read alongside

Five of Cups: Explore how regrets within a memory can be held; Ten of Cups: Develop familiarity into a present-day sense of belonging.

sourceRecord.oneLineSummary: 回忆能提供线索，但今天的关系仍需要重新认识。
sourceRecord.uprightQuickTake: 从过去的好经验中找支持，珍惜朴素而具体的关心。
sourceRecord.reversedQuickTake: 让旧角色松动一点，给新的关系与生活方式留位置。
sourceRecord.hook: 一件旧物可能把你带回某个被善待的下午。圣杯六关心这份熟悉感，也提醒你，回忆停住的时候，人还在继续变化。

sections.title: 花不是摆在远处，而是递到面前
paragraphs: 黄色建筑围成的院落里，两位儿童模样的人物相对而立。较高的一位戴红色兜帽、穿蓝衣，双手捧着一只开有白花的杯子，向较小的一位靠近。较小者披橙红色头巾，穿有深色斑点的衣服，仰头看向对方。
前景另有四只花杯，第六只放在左后方的石台上；杯中的白色星状花朵与绿叶重复出现。远处左侧还有一个背向观者、沿路离开的人影。画面有交换、有屋舍，也有不同方向的行动，不同人物的动作与朝向并不一致。 [查看本篇牌面](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cups06.jpg)

sections.title: Waite 同时记录过去与新环境
paragraphs: Waite《塔罗图解之钥》1911 英文转录以旧花园中的孩子为起点，列出过去、童年记忆与已经消逝的快乐。他也记录另一种相反解释：孩子可能正在陌生环境里接触新关系、新知识。 [Waite 本牌原文](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktcu06.htm)
逆位原文偏向未来与更新。因此本站把正位的记忆和逆位的向前联系起来，同时保留两种读法的开放性；并不把怀旧写成所有读牌者公认的唯一答案。

sections.title: 正位 找出温暖背后的做法
paragraphs: 怀念某个人或某段生活时，问问真正重要的是什么。可能是被认真听完、一起吃饭的节奏，或没有功利目的的帮助。辨认这些具体做法，才能把回忆变成今天可用的东西。
善意可以很简单：记住朋友的偏好，分享一本适合的书，重新练习小时候喜欢的技能。它不必附带要求对方回到从前，也不必变成一笔人情账。

sections.title: 逆位 不必继续扮演旧版本的自己
paragraphs: 逆位可以用于重新认识现在：老朋友的生活改变了，你曾经擅长的角色也可能不再适合。过去形成的亲近感值得珍惜，今天的边界、时间与价值观仍然需要询问。
若你只记得过去最好的一面，试着把当时的困难也写下来；若过去并不温暖，也无需为符合牌意而美化它。更新可以是保留有益经验，同时拒绝继续复制让人难受的相处方式。

sections.title: 把怀念变成小而真实的行动
paragraphs: 与多年不见的同学重逢，先问对方最近在做什么，而不是只重复旧绰号。你们可以共享记忆，也可以接受现在兴趣不再完全相同。
整理旧作品时，找回曾让你享受创作的一个方法，做成今天的小练习。家人说你以前不是这样的，可以平静说明目前的选择和安排；亲近不意味着有义务永远维持原来的分工。

sections.title: 练习 留下一种做法
paragraphs: 挑一段愿意回看的记忆，写下当时发生的具体行动，而非只写那时真好。选一项今天仍合适的做法重新尝试，并注明哪些条件已经不同。若回忆让你不适，可以改选一件近期的小善意。

sections.title: 容易看错的地方
paragraphs: 圣杯六不能证明前任会回来，也不能保证旧关系一定安全。熟悉感容易让人放下警觉，是否重建联系仍要看今天的意愿与行为。画中的儿童是艺术形象，不是现实怀孕、生育或某个孩子命运的证据。
